description: SolidJS createStore split across 12 modules: core, diff, filters, project, selection, search, hierarchy, temporal, annotations, flow, pr-stack, URL sync. The store barrel (store.ts) re-exports the public API. Filter and hierarchy state persist to localStorage keyed by project root. Navigation history tracks a cursor with back/forward.
label: Client State

members.note: AppState type alias. Destructured createStore produces state/setState — the reactive proxy all components read and all state modules write through.
Clears stale view data, calls REST, reloads persisted state, syncs URL params.
Aborts prior in-flight fetch, pushes navigation history, resolves detail from REST or local diff data.
Scopes the graph to traced flow nodes and re-runs the view pipeline.
select or annotate. Determines whether canvas gestures select nodes or draw annotation shapes.
Barrel module. Re-exports from all state modules. Single import point for components.
